summary: Pass run budgets to Apify's native maxTotalChargeUsd cap, retain the live watchdog, and document Xquik's Tweet and Follower Actor workflows.
reason: A polling watchdog can only react after it observes reported spend. The server-side cap protects first runs and non-waiting runs before local polling can react. The Xquik recipes add bounded X research and audience workflows to the published Apify skill.
validated_outcome: Focused CLI tests, go build, go vet, govulncheck, and verify-skill pass. Both Actor recipes use valid CLI flags. Full go test retains unrelated store parent-ID failures reproduced on the base branch.
